text:
Residents:
Priya (50s): Office worker. Weekdays: Out ~08:00-17:30. Home evenings. Weekends: Sleeps in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Movies, reading.
Dana (30s): Afternoon/night shift. Weekdays: Home mornings, out ~13:40-23:00. Weekends: Off, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Baking, gaming, movies, yoga.
Hana (30s): Office worker. Weekdays: Out ~08:00-17:30. Home evenings. Weekends: Sleeps in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Board games, napping, reading.

Object Notes:
Phones: Priya’s phone is on nightstand_b1 at night, gone by 09:00. Hana’s phone is on nightstand_b3 at night, gone by 08:00. Dana’s phone is on nightstand_b2 at night, gone by 10:00. Phones are carried on person when residents are active or leaving.

Keys/Wallets: Priya’s and Hana’s keys/wallets are on entry_table_e1 at night, gone by 09:00. Dana’s keys/wallet are on entry_table_e1 at night, gone by 14:00. These items are typically left at the entry when residents are home in the evening, or taken out when leaving.

Umbrellas: Priya, Hana, and Dana all have umbrellas on entry_floor_e1. They remain there unless taken out for rain.

Water Bottles: Hana’s and Priya’s bottles are on entry_hook_e1 at night, moved to dish_rack_k1 or kitchen_table_k1 in the evening, then gone by 09:00. Dana’s bottle is on entry_hook_e1 at night, gone by 14:00. Bottles are often filled at the sink and dried in the dish rack.

Dishes: Dishes (glasses, plates, bowls, mugs) are generally in cupboard_k1 during the day. They move to sink_k1 or kitchen_table_k1 in the evening for use, then back to cupboard_k1 by 22:00. Shared serving dishes follow a similar pattern.

Clothing/Shoes: Priya’s and Hana’s outerwear (jackets, hats, shoes, sunglasses) and work items (backpacks, laptops, notebooks, pens) are at entry spots at night, gone by 09:00. Dana’s outerwear and work items are at entry spots at night, gone by 14:00. Residents leave outerwear and shoes at the entry when home.

Magazines: Hana’s magazine is on bookshelf_l1 at night, moved to coffee_table_l1 or armchair_l1 in the evening. Dana’s magazine remains on coffee_table_l1. Magazines are read in the living room and returned to the bookshelf.

Blanket: Shared blanket is on armchair_l1 at night, moved to couch_l1 or coffee_table_l1 in the evening.

Remote: Shared remote is on tv_stand_l1 at night, moved to coffee_table_l1 in the evening.

Snack Bowl: Shared snack bowl is in cupboard_k1 at night, moved to sink_k1 or coffee_table_l1 in the evening.

Kitchen Tools: Shared cooking tools (knife, pan, pot, spatula, cutting board, recipe book) are in drawers/cupboards/pantry at night. They move to counter_k1 in the evening for cooking, then back to storage by 21:00.

Yoga Mat: Dana’s yoga mat is in wardrobe_b2 at night, moved to floor_l_l1 in the morning for exercise, then returned.

Vacuum: Shared vacuum is on entry_floor_e1 at night, moved to floor_l_l1 for cleaning, then returned.

Charger: Hana’s charger is on nightstand_b3 at night, moved to desk_b3 in the evening.
